findings.current: If it hadn’t been for this bastard’s snoring, I never would’ve crawled into that capsule.
findings.defect: “Bastard” intensifies the mildly disparaging 이 인간 and erases the source’s distinction from stronger insults used elsewhere in the scene.
findings.rationale: Here 이 인간 functions as an irritated “this guy,” whereas the chapter separately uses stronger forms such as 이 자식 and 새끼 that support “bastard.”
findings.replacement: If it hadn’t been for this guy’s snoring, I never would’ve crawled into that capsule.

findings.current: You of all people should know better.
findings.defect: The singular, specially targeted construction loses the plural admonition directed at both men before Jinho is separately criticized as the goshiwon manager.
findings.rationale: 다 알 만한 사람들이 is plural and means that they are people old enough to know better; the following clause then singles out the manager.
findings.replacement: You’re both old enough to know better.

summary: Faithful overall, with two minor losses in register and addressee scope.
